message.reasoning_content: We need to identify crimes based on facts. Facts: Wang defrauded Hong of 115,000 RMB by false statements about buying house, etc. That's fraud (诈骗罪). Also he later filed false report to police claiming victim defrauded him 640,000 RMB, and had friend give false testimony, intending to cause victim to be criminally prosecuted. That's false reporting (诬告陷害罪) or making false accusations (诬告罪). In Chinese criminal law, "诬告陷害罪" is for false accusation to police causing criminal investigation. So we have two crimes: fraud and false accusation/defamation. Also maybe "伪证罪" for friend but not him. He induced friend to give false testimony, could be "伪证罪" (perjury) but he is not the one testifying. He caused false testimony, could be "帮助伪证罪"? Not sure. The fact says he had friend make false testimony to police. That could be "诬告陷害罪". So answer: 诈骗;诬告陷害<eoa>. Format: [罪名]诈骗;诬告陷害<eoa>.
